solutions.title: Count factors in multiples of five
solutions.strategy: Visit every multiple of five and count how many times it is divisible by five.

timeComplexity.explanation: The total number of factor divisions is bounded by n/5 + n/25 + n/125 + ..., which is linear in n.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only the total and current multiple are stored.

solutions.title: Sum powers of five
solutions.strategy: Repeatedly divide n by five and add how many numbers contribute each power of five.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each step removes a factor of five from n.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only the running total and shrinking n are stored.
